post.originalText:
Same prompt, same effort, 5 AI models: "A lighthouse on a cliff in a thunderstorm at night", one HTML file.

Claude Opus 5.5 (~2.0M tokens)
Gemini Argon 4 (~0.57M)
Claude Sonnet 5.5 (~0.75M)
Fable 5.1 / Muse Spark 1.3

Which would you ship?

#AIEngineering https://t.co/o5sIQpqeJ9

sourceMaterials.text: Few other tests are on their way!
sourceMaterials.author: onmanjrekar

sourceMaterials.text: Rules: every model got the same spec and effort level (high), with no libraries and no hand edits. Every run counts, including one that timed out (Argon needed a retry). Lesson: more tokens didn't mean a better scene. The most expensive build here came 4th.
sourceMaterials.author: onmanjrekar

sourceMaterials.text: Opus: most cohesive scene. Beam sweeps, waves crash with spray, lightning lights the whole sky. Sonnet: almost as good on about a third of the tokens. Argon: brightest beam and most lightning, but foam is drawn as flat white ovals.
sourceMaterials.author: onmanjrekar
